join the team

Du hast erste Erfahrungen im Affiliate-, eCommerce, Creator- oder Social-Media-Umfeld und willst jetzt eigene Verantwortung übernehmen? Als Junior TikTok Shop Manager baust ihre Creator Communities auf und aus. Dein Fokus: Skalierung.

TikTok Shop verändert gerade den gesamten Social Commerce, und wir sind von Anfang an dabei. Als eine der führenden TikTok Shop Agenturen in Deutschland bauen wir Creator-Netzwerke, die nicht nur Content produzieren, sondern echten Umsatz treiben. Wenn du “Driving the future of Social Commerce by building and scaling high-performance TikTok Shop strategies” liest und denkst “Oh yes, ich möchte Teil der Journey werden”, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

der task

Creator Sourcing & Onboarding

  • Du baust das TikTok Shop Affiliate Netzwerk für deine Kunden auf und machst es skalierbar.
  • Du identifizierst und gewinnst monatlich neue Creator, die zur Brand, zur Zielgruppe und zum Produkt passen.
  • Du behältst die Top Creator pro Kunde im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass sie langfristig performen.
  • Du steuerst den Onboarding-Prozess: von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Vertragsabwicklung bis zum ersten Posting.
  • Du entwickelst ein Gespür dafür, welcher Creator zu welcher Brand passt und welcher nicht.

Creator Management & Kommunikation

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für mehrere Affiliates gleichzeitig, hältst die Beziehung warm und gibst klares Feedback.
  • Du erstellst Briefings, die Creator nicht nur informieren, sondern wirklich aktivieren.
  • Du koordinierst Content-Produktionen und achtest auf Output-Qualität und Timelines.

Campaign Management

  • Du planst, setzt auf und wertest Kampagnen für deine Kunden aus.
  • Du suchst Produkte für die Kampagnen aus und steuerst die Sample-Logistik.
  • Du übersetzt virale Hits auf TikTok Shop in deine Kampagnen.

Performance & Optimierung

  • Du trackst die Performance deiner Creator konsequent (GMV, Affiliate-Sales) und weißt, was die Zahlen bedeuten.
  • Du leitest Maßnahmen ab, optimierst das Creator-Setup kontinuierlich und skalierst, was funktioniert.
  • Du bringst deine Learnings strukturiert ins Team ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns neue Standards.

you

  • erste Erfahrung im Affiliate, Creator Management, UGC oder in einem verwandten Marketing-Bereich (Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen mit)
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld oder in einer Marketing-Agentur
  • Echtes Interesse an TikTok, Social Commerce und der Frage, wie Creator Commerce funktioniert (TikTok Shop Vorkenntnisse sind nicht nötig)
  • Organisationstalent: Du behältst den Überblick, auch wenn du mehrere Creator, Brands und Deadlines gleichzeitig managst
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst mit Creatorn auf Augenhöhe und mit Kunden professionell sprechen
  • Datenaffinität: Du arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen und nutzt sie, um bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du wartest nicht auf Anleitung, sondern packst an
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch

das erwartet dich

  • Strukturiertes Onboarding und persönliches Mentoring, damit du schnell sicher wirst und früh eigene Verantwortung übernimmst
  • Ein anspruchsvolles, dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld in einer der führenden und größten Meta & TikTok Performance Marketing Agenturen im deutschsprachigen Raum
  • Zusammenarbeit mit spannenden Brands wie Ankerkraut, More Nutrition, Waterdrop u.v.m.
  • Ein top ausgestattetes TikTok Shop Studio für die Live Streams unserer Kunden
  • Ein dynamisches Team mit starker Hands-on-Mentalität und eigeninitiativer Arbeit
  • 450 qm Loftbüro, lockere Arbeitsatmosphäre und die coolsten Teamevents
  • Die neueste Apple-Technik als Arbeitsausstattung
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Mobility & Sport: KVB JobTicket, Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Bikes, Fitnessstudio
  • Feel Good: Warmes Mittagessen, Healthy Snack Bar, Free Drinks & ADBAKER Kaffee, Gaming-Ecke

Business Operations Lead

description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <ul> <li><strong>Permanent position available with a considerable portfolio of works for the next 5+ years</strong></li> <li><strong>To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects.</strong></li> <li><strong>To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards.</strong></li> <li><strong>To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability.</strong></li> <li><strong>To work with the best.</strong></li> <li><strong>Excellent package on offer with room for negotiations</strong></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><strong>About Kirby Group Engineering</strong><br>Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.</p> <p></p></div><p><strong>Role Purpose</strong><br>The Electrical QC Inspector ensures that electrical systems, components, and installations comply with safety and quality standards. The role includes conducting inspections, testing, and documenting results to verify that work meets project requirements, codes, and industry standards.<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><strong>Key Functions:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Inspection of Electrical Installations:</strong> Inspect electrical systems and installations during and after the construction process to ensure compliance with safety regulations, project specifications, and industry standards (e.g., NEC, IEC).</li> <li><strong>Quality Control Monitoring:</strong> Monitor and verify electrical works for quality control, ensuring all installations adhere to engineering drawings, plans, and specifications.</li> <li><strong>Testing and Verification:</strong> Perform a variety of electrical tests (e.g., continuity tests, insulation resistance tests, voltage tests) to verify the functionality and safety of installed systems.</li> <li><strong>Documentation: </strong>Maintain and complete detailed inspection records, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and testing logs. Provide feedback to supervisors and project managers regarding quality-related issues.</li> <li><strong>Non-Conformance</strong> Handling: Identify and report non-conformance items, working with relevant personnel to resolve issues, ensuring corrective actions are implemented.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with Site Engineers:</strong> Work closely with engineers and contractors to resolve quality-related issues and ensure work is executed according to project specifications.</li> <li><strong>Safety Compliance:</strong> Ensure all electrical work is performed safely, adhering to workplace safety standards and relevant electrical codes.</li> <li><strong>Inspection of Materials:</strong> Inspect incoming electrical materials, ensuring that components meet specified standards and quality levels before being used in installations.</li> <li><strong>Continuous Improvement:</strong> Provide feedback and suggestions for improvements in processes, materials, and quality control systems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Necessary requirement of the Quality Control Inspector:</strong><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>A strong Trade/Construction background and/or a third level qualification in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering.</li> <li>A minimum of 3 year’s experience in a lead/managerial position.</li> <li>Excellent communication and people skills with the ability to adapt.</li> <li>Ability to work on own initiative is essential as well as taking direction where required.</li> <li>Ability to work in conjunction with others and be a team player.</li> <li>Commitment to working to the highest possible standards and delivering high quality results.</li> <li>Proficient in the use of MS office, BIM 360 Field Management or similar platforms.</li> <li>Data Centre, Pharma or similar experience.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><strong>Desired competencies / special roles requirements</strong><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Experience in Electrical Testing &amp; Commissioning</li> <li>CompEx Ex01-04 training</li> <li>Experience of working on HV/MV systems. ‘Authorised person’ experience</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><strong><em>For more information on this or opportunities based in Ireland, UK or Europe contact the&nbsp;Talent Acquisition Team in Kirby Group confidentially on&nbsp;+353 (0)1 454 0411 or apply in confidence.</em></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>For more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page (<a href="https://careers.kirbygroup.com/vacancies/">Vacancies - Kirby Group Careers</a>) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411.</em></p> <p><em>Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. We are hiring a Senior Performance Engineer to grow our pre-training efficiency team. If you are excited about making models fast and scaling them to thousands of GPUs, this is the role for you! Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision‑making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. About the role: You will engineer the systems required to train foundation models at scale. Your objective is to maximize hardware utilization and training throughput on our large-scale GPU clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs). You will work at the intersection of deep learning frameworks, distributed systems, and GPU microarchitecture, eliminating bottlenecks from the Python layer down to the GPU kernel. This role is for Aleph Alpha Research GmbH. Your responsibilities: End-to-End Optimization: Profile training loops using PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute to identify system- and kernel-level bottlenecks in order to maximize model throughput. Distributed Strategy and Topology: Configure and tune composite parallelism strategies (e.g. TP, DP, HSDP/FSDP, EP), optimizing load balance, minimizing critical-path bottlenecks, and managing communication-to-computation trade-offs for large-scale LLM training. Hardware-Aware Modeling: Partner with AI Researchers to define model architectures for hardware efficiency without compromising convergence. Your Profile Basic Qualifications Are proficient in Python and the PyTorch library. Have a strong engineering background in parallel and/or distributed systems with proven track record of excellence. Have hands-on experience with modern machine learning techniques (especially large language models and their life cycle). Deeply understand the CUDA programming model. Have experience in distributed programming with APIs like NCCL or MPI. Have experience analysing profiling traces with tools such as PyTorch Profiler and Nvidia Nsight. Please note this role requires regular on-site collaboration in Heidelberg as a member of the Training Efficiency Team. Preferred Qualifications Contributions to modern distributed training frameworks (e.g., TorchTitan, Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed). Familiarity with low-precision training formats (MXFP4, MXFP8) and their impact on numerical stability and throughput. A deep understanding of NCCL communication primitives, NVSHMEM or CUDA IPC and their performance. A proven track record of implementing and optimising modern transformer-based model training. A proven track record working on the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture. title: Director UX Design
description: <h1><strong>About HelloFresh</strong></h1> <p>HelloFresh Group reaches more than 6 million customers across 16 markets through a portfolio of 8 consumer brands — from meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to pet food and specialty products. HelloTech, our global technology division, builds the digital consumer experience across Berlin, Warsaw, and North America: the apps, the personalization, the discovery moments, and everything in between that turns food into something people genuinely look forward to.</p> <p>Design is core to how we compete. Our Consumer UX team designs end-to-end experiences across all 8 brands, and we hold a high quality bar — internally, our “zest-appeal” framework defines design excellence from baseline usability through to best-in-class, surprise-and-delight craft. We are also moving fast to an AI-native way of working, where AI rethinks discovery, prototyping, and the path from design to code. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.</p> <h1><strong>About the role</strong></h1> <p>This year we are doubling down on craft, execution, and design leadership. In a world where it is easier than ever to get software to 75% built, it is the last 25% — the polish, the motion, the detail customers actually feel — that decides whether a consumer experience is merely useful or genuinely loved. Millions of people open our apps every week to feed themselves and their families; the final 10% is the difference between a transaction and a habit.</p> <p>This is a build-and-scale role, not a maintenance one. We are hiring a design leader to own a consumer experience domain within the Consumer mega alliance, raise the quality bar across it, grow a high-performing team, and build the design-technology and AI-native capability that turns ambitious ideas into beautifully executed, shipped products. We need a maker and a leader who leads through the work — not a strategy-only or people-management-only role.</p> <p>The level — Director or Senior Director — will be set by the candidate’s experience and the final scope of the domain. We are open to both.</p> <h1><strong>What You’ll Do: The Recipe</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Lead from the front. </strong>Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary team — UX, UI, content, and localization — across multiple consumer surfaces. Stay hands-on in the work: review designs, jump into critiques, and drive clarity.</li> <li><strong>Turn ambiguity into clarity. </strong>Solve problems from first principles, not templates. Help your team make hard decisions, focus on outcomes over process, and install just the right amount of structure and rigour to ship great work at speed.</li> <li><strong>Set and uphold an extremely high craft bar. </strong>From UX flow to polished UI — layout, typography, motion, micro-interaction, and visual storytelling. Be the design-quality amplifier who notices the details others miss and pushes work to where it needs to be, coaching the team to our quality tenets.</li> <li><strong>Own a consumer experience domain end-to-end. </strong>Take accountability for the quality and delivery of experiences across the customer journey, from problem framing to shipped product across our brands and 16 markets. Drive design excellence through every detail.</li> <li><strong>Build design-technology capability. </strong>Champion and scale our design system (Zest) and modern UI foundations. Close the gap between design and engineering through prototyping, design-to-code workflows, and component quality — making design and engineering faster together.</li> <li><strong>Make us AI-native. </strong>Treat AI as an active part of how design gets done — accelerating discovery, generating and validating prototypes, and shortening design-to-delivery. Define the quality bar AI-assisted workflows must meet, and help the company rewrite how consumer products get built in the AI era.</li> <li><strong>Partner deeply with Product and Engineering. </strong>Align on priorities, make tradeoffs, unblock delivery, and move fast. Advocate clearly and persistently for the right experience, and raise the ambition of the partners around you.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Team leadership. </strong>A track record of leading and growing high-performing design teams in product-first, consumer (B2C) companies — hiring, coaching, and developing designers at all levels, from IC to managers.</li> <li><strong>High agency. </strong>You thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, push for the right solution rather than the convenient one, and lean in to make things happen without waiting for permission.</li> <li><strong>A bias to ship. </strong>Demonstrated success driving teams to ship great software at scale, not just making decks about it — owning execution across a product line and a portfolio of features.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional craft and product taste. </strong>Strong visual and interaction sensibility and a high personal bar for detail. You know what great looks like for a consumer audience, and you can help teams get there — across hierarchy, motion, and micro-interaction.</li> <li><strong>Design-technologist mindset. </strong>Fluency at the design–engineering boundary: design systems, component architecture, prototyping in code or advanced tools, and a practical grasp of front-end constraints.</li> <li><strong>AI-native practice. </strong>You already use AI across the design workflow — for insight synthesis, rapid prototyping, and design-to-code — and have a point of view on scaling it responsibly with a high quality bar. Fluency with tools like Figma, Claude, and similar is expected.</li> <li><strong>Scale and systems thinking. </strong>Experience designing and maintaining quality across a multi-brand or multi-market consumer ecosystem, balancing consistency with brand-specific character.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h1> <ol> <li>Your team consistently delivers high-quality consumer product work at speed.</li> <li>You have hired exceptional talent and helped your existing team grow in craft and execution maturity.</li> <li>Experience quality in your domain is visibly higher — the last 10% is sweated, and it shows in what customers feel.</li> <li>Product and engineering leaders love partnering with you because you unlock progress and raise the ambition.</li> <li>Design systems and AI-native workflows in your domain make the whole team faster without sacrificing craft.</li> <li>You are a key player in shaping how HelloFresh builds consumer product in the AI era — writing new playbooks, not following old ones.</li> </ol> <h1><strong>What We Offer: The Toppings</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Scale and impact. </strong>Shape experiences for 6+ million customers across 8 brands and 16 markets.</li> <li><strong>A craft-and-AI-first culture. </strong>Leadership that champions experience quality, innovation, and AI-native ways of working from the top of the organization.</li> <li><strong>Real ownership. </strong>End-to-end accountability for your domain, with the autonomy to set and raise the bar.</li> <li><strong>Growth. </strong>A defined leadership track and the chance to expand scope as the alliance scales.</li> <li><strong>Global collaboration. </strong>Work with experienced product, engineering, and design partners across HelloTech’s international teams.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="gmail_default" style="font-size: small;"> <div> <p><strong>Why Mozilla?</strong></p> <p>Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.</p> <p>The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.</p> <p><strong>About this team and role:</strong></p> <p>This role is part of the Governance, Risk &amp; Compliance (GRC) function within Mozilla's Security team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise, and GRC functions across the organization, aligned with the mission to build a safe and secure internet. This role is responsible for maintaining and advancing Mozilla's Information Security Management System (ISMS) and supporting our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 compliance programs — from policy and control design through audit readiness and certification.</p> <p>The ideal candidate has hands-on experience across the full breadth of a compliance program, is comfortable building process where none yet exists, and works well with a wide range of cross-functional stakeholders.</p> <strong>What you'll do:</strong> <ul data-start="99" data-end="1504"> <li data-section-id="g3zchj" data-start="99" data-end="261">Maintain and mature the ISMS, including the Statement of Applicability (SoA), risk treatment plans, and the Management Review Meeting (MRM) process and cadence.</li> <li data-section-id="a98hti" data-start="262" data-end="469">Support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 audit execution—helping determine scope, preparing evidence and narrative artifacts, participating in auditor interviews and walkthroughs, and resolving auditor findings.</li> <li data-section-id="1mvm37t" data-start="470" data-end="644">Contribute to the SOC 2 System Description and other audit-specific narrative documentation, ensuring they accurately reflect the organization's actual control environment.</li> <li data-section-id="1c5myfc" data-start="645" data-end="728">Track gaps and remediation efforts arising from readiness assessments and audits.</li> <li data-section-id="16h0052" data-start="729" data-end="895">Lead the policy program—driving policy creation, revision, and cross-functional review cycles to keep the security policy set current, enforceable, and audit-ready.</li> <li data-section-id="1wdqpxi" data-start="896" data-end="1013">Support compliance scaling as additional products or business units pursue readiness assessments and certification.</li> <li data-section-id="xka45v" data-start="1014" data-end="1161">Support the internal audit function, partnering with internal or third-party resources as needed to meet ISO 27001's internal audit requirements.</li> <li data-section-id="rzexta" data-start="1162" data-end="1374">Partner closely with Engineering, IT, Legal, Privacy, People teams, and product leadership to gather evidence, drive control ownership, and translate compliance requirements into practical, adoptable practices.</li> <li raw.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager (m/f/d) - Sales Ops & Strategy
raw.description:
🎤 Why voize? Because we're more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we're looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 Your Mission: Turn growth into a system!

Hi, I'm Jeremy, I lead RevOps at voize. I'm hiring the person who owns sales operations as we scale: new markets, new segments, and a sales team growing fast in all of them.

As Senior Sales Operations Manager, you build the GTM engine that carries us past €100M ARR, working in close partnership with our sales leaders, with genuinely good tooling and AI ways of working behind you. Joining at this point in our hyper-growth journey is rare: big enough that the problems are real, early enough that you shape how they get solved. What you build now compounds for years, and so does your scope.

This role is roughly 60% building new process and 40% running what exists. If you want a mature machine to optimize, this is not it. If you want to design the machine, for now and for what comes next, it is.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Territory, compensation & capacity. Own the global account, territory and book-of-business model. Carve books for new AEs, keep segmentation honest as we add hospitals and new geos, and build the capacity and quota model that underpins our fiscal plan.

  • Forecasting. Run the forecast process end to end with our VP Sales and team leads: weekly hygiene, submit and roll-up, quarterly commit. Diagnose why deals slip, and stand the process up in the US, France and UK as those teams ramp.

  • Insights the company acts on. Define the sales metrics we run on, then turn pipeline and funnel data into the analysis that steers board meetings, monthly GTM reviews and weekly deal inspection. You define what gets measured; our data and BI team build the layer underneath.

  • Commercial process. Design how non-standard deals are managed at voize. You set the rules and stand the function up; you will not be the approval queue.

  • Process and tool enablement. In close collaboration with sales enablement, you make sure what gets built actually gets adopted, partnering with leaders, AEs and SDRs to prioritize the work with the most impact.

  • The GTM stack, built AI-first. Own the sales side of CRM and the tools around it. Automate the manual layer with Claude, n8n and whatever else earns its place, and take a real position on which tooling we buy next as we scale.

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years in revenue operations, sales operations or GTM strategy, at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company or in strategy/tech consulting, VC or M&A before an operating role. You have seen what breaks as a sales team scales, because you were the one who fixed it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder skills. You partner with VPs and team leads as an equal, push back with evidence, and get change adopted by people who do not report to you.

  • Sharp analytical instincts and deep CRM fluency. Expert in spreadsheets, comfortable reading data in a BI tool, and you have owned a HubSpot or Salesforce instance rather than just worked in one. You go deep on data enrichment and spot the patterns that keep our data model trustworthy.

  • You have supported forecasting. You can talk methodology, where it broke, and what you changed. Same for a territory or quota plan you built and aligned with sales leadership.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and hands-on. You are comfortable with no playbook, you prioritize ruthlessly, and you ship rather than produce recommendations.

  • AI-native as a builder, not just a user. You already use Claude, n8n or similar to remove manual work from your own day, and you can point to something concrete you shipped that way.

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will take on real problems, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany

  • Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

  • Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses

  • You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀

We look forward to your application and can't wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

raw.title: Staff AI Deployment Strategist - DACH
raw.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As Staff AI Deployment Strategist, you will shape how some of the most ambitious enterprises in the DACH region adopt frontier AI at scale.

This is a senior, high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You will work directly on Mistral’s most strategic opportunities and largest deliveries, helping customers move from ambition to measurable business outcomes. You will frame complex AI transformation programs, turn executive priorities into actionable roadmaps, and ensure that Mistral delivers systems that are valuable, scalable, and trusted.

You will also act as a senior sponsor on our most critical customer programs, bringing judgment, structure, and delivery excellence to high-stakes engagements. Your mandate is to raise the ambition and quality of AI adoption: helping customers identify where AI can create step-change value, making the right trade-offs, and ensuring that execution matches the strategic promise.

This role is ideal for an experienced strategy consultant, transformation leader, or senior operator who wants to move from advising on change to building it directly with frontier AI technology.

 

What You Will Do

 

  • Shape high-impact AI transformations

    • Partner closely with Mistral’s Sales leadership in DACH to qualify opportunities, align on account strategy, and drive executive engagement.

    • Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify where frontier AI can create material business value.

    • Structure complex opportunities into clear, credible, and executable transformation programs.

    • Translate strategic ambition into delivery roadmaps, success metrics, and operating plans.

    • Help customers make the right trade-offs between ambition, feasibility, speed, and long-term scalability.

  • Sponsor Mistral’s most strategic deliveries

    • Act as a senior sponsor on the largest and most complex customer programs, primarily in DACH and potentially cross-region as priorities evolve.

    • Ensure delivery quality, executive alignment, and measurable business impact.

    • Anticipate risks, unblock decisions, and help teams navigate ambiguity in high-stakes environments.

    • Bring senior judgment to moments where scope, resources, timelines, or expected value need to be clarified.

  • Build repeatable deployment excellence

    • Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable approaches, playbooks, and patterns.

    • Raise the bar for how AI programs are qualified, framed, delivered, and scaled.

    • Act as a senior relay for the Solutions organization in the region, helping teams adopt shared best practices, adapt them thoughtfully to local market specificities when needed, and strengthen the quality of execution.

    • Work hand in hand with Solutions leadership to connect customer realities, delivery patterns, and field feedback into practical ways of improving how Mistral deploys AI.

    • Help codify what great enterprise AI deployment looks like across industries and use cases.

    • Contribute to a Solutions culture that combines strategic clarity, technical depth, and strong execution.

  • Develop and multiply senior DS impact

    • Coach Deployment Strategists on strategic problem-solving, executive communication, and delivery leadership.

    • Help teams raise the quality of their work on the highest-impact opportunities.

    • Identify capability gaps and contribute to hiring, staffing, and development priorities.

    • Act as a force multiplier across accounts, teams, and regions where your experience can have the highest leverage.

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

You are a senior, highly capable professional with strong executive presence, excellent business judgment, and a track record of leading complex strategic or transformation work.

Typical indicators we’re looking for include:

  • 8 to 10+ years of professional experience in strategy consulting, digital transformation, AI, enterprise technology, or a similarly demanding environment.

  • Experience operating at Partner, Principal, Engagement Manager, Director, or equivalent level in a top-tier strategy consulting or transformation context.

  • A strong ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify value, and turn strategy into execution.

  • Experience leading large accounts, complex programs, or senior customer relationships.

  • The credibility to engage with executives and C-level stakeholders on business priorities, trade-offs, and impact.

  • Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Comfort working at the frontier of technology, even when solutions are evolving quickly and the path is not fully defined.

  • A low-ego, high-ownership mindset and a desire to build with customers and teams, not just advise from a distance.

  • Fluency in English; German is a strong plus.

 

We are looking for adaptable, low-ego team players who are passionate about turning AI vision into reality and delivering transformative impact for our customers.

 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview 

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Werkstudent Creative Design (m/w/d)
description: Wer sind wir? Wir sind eine stark wachsende Google Ads Agentur mit Sitz in München. Unser dynamisches Team aus Digital Natives betreut die spannendsten E-Commerce Brands und macht sie zu den Marktführern im DACH-Markt. Um unser ambitioniertes Wachstumsziel im Bereich SEA zu erreichen, suchen wir dich als kreativen Kopf für unser Team. Deine Mission: Du entwirfst herausragende Creatives, die nicht nur ins Auge fallen, sondern auch unsere Kunden im E-Commerce auf Google Ads glänzen lassen. Als zentraler Teil unseres Creative-Teams unterstützt du unsere kreative Leitung und sorgst dafür, dass sowohl Kundenprojekte als auch interne To-dos schnell und in Top-Qualität umgesetzt werden. Wenn du eine Leidenschaft für visuelles Storytelling hast und lernen willst, wie man Designs entwickelt, die wirklich konvertieren, dann bist du hier genau richtig! Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Als Werkstudent im Grafikdesign bist du die treibende Kraft hinter unseren visuellen Werbemitteln und trägst maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Kundenkampagnen bei. Deine täglichen Aufgaben umfassen: Creative-Erstellung für Google Ads: Du konzipierst und gestaltest wirkungsvolle Werbemittel (statische Grafiken & Videos), die auf Google Ads für hohe Klickraten und Conversions sorgen. Markenkonsistenz: Du erstellst CI-konforme Online-Werbemittel und sorgst für einen einheitlichen und professionellen Auftritt unserer Kunden über verschiedene Plattformen hinweg. KI-gestütztes Design: Du nutzt innovative KI-Tools, um den Designprozess zu beschleunigen, neue kreative Möglichkeiten zu erschließen und die Bildbearbeitung zu optimieren. Strategischer Input: Du entwickelst ein Verständnis für die wichtigsten KPIs, bringst proaktiv kreative Ideen für Kampagnen ein und hilfst dabei, Design-Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten zu treffen. Interne Grafik-Power: Du unterstützt das Team schnell und zuverlässig bei internen Design-Aufgaben, von Präsentationen über Social-Media-Grafiken bis hin zu Bannern. Deine Chance: Du arbeitest direkt mit Heike, unserer kreativen Leitung, zusammen, lernst von den Besten und erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Welt des Performance-Marketings. Hier kannst du dein theoretisches Wissen praktisch anwenden, über dich hinauswachsen und den Grundstein für deine Karriere im digitalen Marketing legen. Qualifikation Kreativität & Leidenschaft: Deine Passion für Design ist ansteckend. Du denkst "out of the box", bringst frische Ideen mit und hast ein Growth Mindset – du siehst Probleme als Chancen und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung. Design-Skills: Du beherrschst Photoshop oder Figma im Schlaf und hast gute Kenntnisse in der Adobe Creative Cloud (z.B. Illustrator). Erfahrung mit Videobearbeitungstools wie CapCut ist ein großes Plus. Erfahrung: Du hast idealerweise 1-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Grafikbereich, zum Beispiel durch Praktika, eine Ausbildung als Mediengestalter oder erste Jobs in Voll- oder Teilzeit. Zielgruppen-Empathie: Du kannst dich mühelos in die Zielgruppen und deren "Pain Points" in verschiedensten Branchen hineinversetzen und leitest daraus treffsichere Designs ab. Neugier & Trendgespür: Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für den Einsatz von KI im Kreativbereich und ein starkes Interesse an aktuellen Design- und Marketingtrends. Persönlichkeit: Du bist ein organisierter und ergebnisorientierter Teamplayer, der sich weiterentwickeln möchte und strukturiert an Aufgaben herangeht . Benefits Die Chance, unser außergewöhnliches Wachstum signifikant mitzugestalten Agenturgründer, die eine klare Vision für die Agentur haben und das Wachstum aller Mitarbeitenden proaktiv fördern Ein ambitioniertes Team, in dessen positiven Arbeitsatmosphäre du dich wohlfühlen wirst. Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe im Team und kurze Entscheidungswege – hier machen deine Ideen und deine Arbeit den Unterschied. Du bist kein kleines Zahnrad im System, sondern kannst Prozesse prägend mitgestalten! Legendäre Team Events und Workations, die dir in Erinnerung bleiben werden. Benefits wie neuestes Apple Equipment, Wellpass und das Bezahlen von Kursen & Co. sind für uns selbstverständlich - bei allem anderen: Lass uns einfach darüber reden! Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens in München suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „IT-Systemadministrator Web & Applikationen (m/w/d)“.

Aufgaben

  • Als IT-Systemadministrator Web & Applikationen (m/w/d) administrieren und betreuen Sie Web- und Applikationsserver und sorgen für einen sicheren und stabilen Betrieb
  • Zudem übernehmen Sie Konfigurationen, Updates und Systemanpassungen und entwickeln die bestehende Serverlandschaft kontinuierlich weiter
  • Darüber hinaus überwachen Sie die Systeme, analysieren Monitoring- und Logdaten und beheben auftretende Störungen
  • Zusätzlich unterstützen Sie Anwendungsentwickler und externe Dienstleister und wirken bei IT-Projekten sowie der Optimierung von Deployment- und Automatisierungsprozessen mit
  • Dabei unterstützen Sie bei der Weiterentwicklung der IT-Infrastruktur und übernehmen perspektivisch weitere Aufgaben rund um Datenbanken und Cloud-Umgebungen

Qualifikation

  • Grundlage bildet eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration (m/w/d), Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung (m/w/d) oder ein Studium der Informatik
  • Besonders passend ist Berufserfahrung als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d), Systemadministrator (m/w/d) oder IT-Administrator (m/w/d), idealerweise im Umfeld von Web- und Applikationsservern
  • Sie bringen Erfahrung im IT-Infrastrukturmanagement sowie in der Administration gängiger Web- und Applikationsplattformen mit
  • Zusätzlich sind Kenntnisse in Scripting, Versionsverwaltung und Automatisierung von Vorteil, ebenso Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken, SQL oder Cloud-Umgebungen
  • Wichtig sind ein gutes Verständnis für IT-Sicherheit sowie sichere Deutschkenntnisse

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten in Voll- oder Teilzeit (ab 30 h/Woche)
  • Sicherheit: Unbefristete Festanstellung im Rahmen der Direktvermittlung
  • Zentrale Lage: Moderne Büroräumlichkeiten in zentraler Lage
  • Weiterentwicklung: Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Team-Spirit: Sympathische Kollegen, wertschätzendes Miteinander und kurze Entscheidungswege

title: Staff Software Engineer
description: <p>OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century, we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.</p> <p>We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions.&nbsp;We are actively embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, combining nearly a century of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that were simply not possible before.&nbsp;We exist because travel moves the world, and we move travel. By transforming complexity into clarity and questions into answers, we give our partners the intelligence they need to thrive in an evolving world. For more information visit <a href="https://www.oag.com/">www.oag.com</a><br><br></p> <div class="jss-po-ats-3-250 jss-po-ats-3-252"> <div class="mce-content-body"> <p><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE:</strong></p> <p>OAG Digital is the team turning our world-class data into a product-led growth engine: a unified experience where customers can discovery, try, pay and use on their own. We build the platform customers use to find, buy and use our data, and the intelligence products that turn that data into answers.</p> <p>This is the most senior individual contributor role on the technical side of Digital. Its purpose is to turn the Digital strategy into a technical strategy that delivers it: deciding what gets built, in what order and to what standard, so the business can sell what it has committed to sell. A decision taken in one team should still work in another, our promises to customers on access, security, reliability and cost should hold on every channel, and the hardest problems should get solved once.</p> <p>You’ll work across two areas. Core is the platform backbone: identity, auth, entitlements, billing, usage metering and the infrastructure everything else depends on. Intelligence is the layer above the data: AI-powered insights, predictive models built on Databricks and Snowflake, anomaly detection, and agentic features.</p> <p>The role is hands-on. You’ll write production code on the hardest parts of the platform while setting direction, reviewing designs and helping other engineers do better work. We care about UX as much as throughput, and we’re AI-native: tooling is part of how we develop, not an afterthought.</p> <p>This role can be worked remotely from anywhere in the UK only. Please note that we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship, so applicants will need the existing right to work in the UK.<br><br></p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build the hardest parts of the platform, hands on: how customers get to the right data and products, how that access is controlled, and what it costs us to serve. Stay close enough to the code that the design still holds once it’s built</li> <li>Set the technical direction for problems that cross team boundaries: how customers are identified, what they’re allowed to use, how usage is measured and charged, and how existing customers and older systems move onto the new platform. Write the design down, get agreement, and stay with it through delivery so teams build to one approach rather than several</li> <li>Set the standard for products built on AI and machine learning: define what a feature must do before it ships (show where its answer came from, be honest about how current the data is, fail predictably, be tested repeatably). Set the technical brief for data science teams, including how a model will be judged and the speed and cost it has to work within, and push back when a model isn’t the right tool</li> <li>Work with the teams and partners outside Digital who build against your designs, including other parts of OAG and third parties. Share designs early, take feedback, change course where they’re right, and make the call when a cross-team decision has been open too long</li> <li>Integrate AI models, data pipelines and event-driven systems on Databricks and Snowflake into the Intelligence layer</li> <li>Improve how the whole of Digital builds software: review designs and code beyond your own team, mentor senior engineers, and make the good way to do something the easy way. title: Senior Growth Manager - EMEA
description: <h2>Who Are We?</h2> <p>RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.</p> <p>We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.</p> <p>RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&amp;A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.</p> <h2>Role Overview</h2> <p>As a Senior Growth Manager based in London, you will own a portfolio of strategically significant accounts across the UK and Western EMEA, driving revenue retention and growth for some of the most commercially important relationships in the region. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will operate with full autonomy from day one: leading your own growth plans, managing executive-level client relationships, and executing across the full account lifecycle without co-management.</p> <p>You will work closely with cross-functional teams across Growth, Analytics, and Operations to launch and optimize campaigns, surface performance insights, and translate data into decisions that move the business. You will report to the EMEA Growth lead and collaborate with a lean, senior team that moves fast and holds itself to a high standard.</p> <p>This role sits at the heart of RZR's EMEA strategy. The region manages a combined book of over $110K DRR across 30+ accounts, with a strong new business pipeline, and we need a senior operator who can own a meaningful portion of that portfolio independently and grow it.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Revenue Retention &amp; Growth</h3> <ul> <li>Drive net growth to meet or exceed revenue targets across your assigned portfolio</li> <li>Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities while actively managing churn risk and re-activation plays</li> <li>Drive product adoption and expansion to increase revenue quality and account depth</li> <li>Proactively surface client needs and gaps to inform both account strategy and commercial planning</li> </ul> <h3>Client Ownership &amp; Strategy</h3> <ul> <li>Lead account retention and growth plans with a multi-quarter forward view and clear, measurable milestones</li> <li>Build strong client relationships at all levels, from performance marketers to C-suite stakeholders</li> <li>Use QBRs and strategic sessions to drive progress, deepen engagement, and secure long-term commitment</li> <li>Communicate product capabilities and market changes in ways that are clear, compelling, and directly relevant to each client's business</li> <li>Provide market insights and best practices that position RZR as a strategic partner, not just a vendor</li> </ul> <h3>Campaign Management &amp; Performance Insights</h3> <ul> <li>Work with internal teams to launch, execute, and optimize campaigns aligned to client goals</li> <li>Monitor account health and identify performance issues before they become client concerns</li> <li>Deliver actionable insights tied to business impact, not just metrics</li> <li>Recommend creative and strategy adjustments to counter performance fatigue and sustain growth</li> </ul> <h3>Cross-Functional Collaboration</h3> <ul> <li>Lead cross-functional coordination to meet client expectations and execute growth plans on time</li> <li>Maintain clear escalation paths to resolve issues quickly and protect the client relationship</li> <li>Conduct client training sessions, platform walkthroughs, and onboarding as needed</li> </ul> <h3>Operational Excellence</h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline documentation, and reporting with full personal accountability</li> <li>Ensure financial alignment including timely invoicing and budget tracking</li> <li>Report accurately and consistently to regional EMEA and global leadership</li> </ul> <h2>Required Skills and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>3 to 5 years of experience in mobile advertising, including at least 3 years in a client-facing growth or account management role</li> <li>Solid working knowledge of the programmatic advertising ecosystem</li> <li>Familiarity with the UK market; established relationships with key advertisers and agencies across the UK and Western EMEA are a significant advantage</li> <li>Proven ability to build high-touch client relationships, manage in-person engagements, and calibrate the right frequency and depth of contact</li> <li>Track record of independently managing and scaling commercial accounts, identifying and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities without hand-holding</li> <li>Comfortable managing the full account lifecycle in a commercially dense, competitive market</li> <li>Willingness to travel regularly and engage clients and team members in person</li> <li>Ability to adapt quickly in a high-growth environment and lead growth initiatives with limited structural support</li> <li>Strong communication and presentation skills, able to engage confidently with clients from campaign managers to C-level executives</li> <li>Strong collaborator across diverse, globally distributed teams</li> <li>Familiarity with data analytics, machine learning, and advertising technology is a plus</li> <li>Fluent in English; an additional European language is an advantage</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join RZR in London?</h2> <ul> <li>Step into direct ownership of a commercially significant EMEA portfolio from day one: full autonomy, full accountability, and no co-management required</li> <li>Work with a privacy-centric, AI-driven programmatic platform as the UK market deepens and the product portfolio (User Acquisition, Retargeting, CTV) actively expands</li> <li>Earn a competitive base salary plus a structured commission plan where your performance directly determines your earnings ceiling</li> <li>Gain exposure to global advertisers, senior cross-functional teams, and major industry events across EMEA and beyond, with regular in-person client engagement built into the role</li> <li>Join a small, senior team where your contributions are visible, your voice carries weight, and direct access to leadership accelerates your development</li> </ul> <h2>Our Values</h2> <p>RZR operates by eight core behaviours: Extreme Ownership · Move Fast · Drive for Excellence · Proactive Communication · Courage · Curiosity · Deliver Results · Manage Ambiguity</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>RZR is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>RZR is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.</p> <p>RZR provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Social Account Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ogilvy &nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports &amp; entertainment, PR &amp; social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named <a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-brings-home-network-year-2026-cannes-lions-international-festival-creativity">Network of the Year</a> at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-tops-warc-effective-100-creative-100-4th-straight-year" data-outlook-id="e2c78315-ff05-4544-925f-9288319dea2c">ranks</a><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>For more information, visit <a href="http://www.ogilvy.com/" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="39833259-880d-4fd8-930f-0d84b1c14850">Ogilvy.com</a>, and follow us on<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="735e393e-6e8a-4ca8-804a-74f1bd8166b6">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ogilvy" data-outlook-id="d10960ce-761b-48c5-81d5-0a7c4cc6013a">X</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="92ffcb70-6ca7-4d9a-88d5-c130e36e6c4f"> Instagram</a>, and<a href="https://www.facebook.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="3bd2010d-00a2-401b-8cfb-7e8c24deac52"> Facebook.</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite&nbsp;cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel&nbsp;in a single company –&nbsp;powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open,&nbsp;to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit&nbsp;<u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Social Account Director<br></strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Department:</strong> Social<br><strong>Location: </strong>London<br><strong>Contact&nbsp;type:</strong> 12-Month Fixed Term Contract (Maternity Cover)<br><strong>Full Time/Part time:</strong> Full Time<br><strong>Reporting into:</strong> Client Partner</p> <p><strong><br><br></strong></p> <p><strong>About Ogilvy: <br><br></strong>Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. The agency specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fuelled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Lloyds Banking Group, Madri, Unilever and Mondelēz International.&nbsp;<br><br>Ogilvy’s influencer marketing practice is the largest globally; we are proud to be the most awarded influencer agency for six years running and the recipient of the Cannes Grand Prix for Social &amp; Creator for two consecutive years.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><br>Ogilvy UK also hosts the world’s biggest festival of behavioural science and creativity, Nudgestock – which is now in its 12th year. James Murphy is the CEO of Ogilvy Group UK, which includes Ogilvy UK and New Commercial Arts (NCA), a boutique creative agency he co-founded in 2020, recently acquired by WPP.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>About this role:</strong></p> <p>Social and content has never been more important for clients. Showing up authentically, with intention, across social platforms helps brands connect with their audiences. It helps them to sell and serve better.</p> <p>This role provides the opportunity to work on a really exciting client that have a portfolio of soft drinks brands. You will have the opportunity to manage key campaigns across the year that will involve working with our strategy, creative and production team to deliver best in class campaigns and content.<br>This role is perfect for someone that has a wide knowledge of social – they will have experience managing content and campaigns that build brand advocacy as well having an understanding of how to create hard working assets that drive to purchase. The ideal candidate will know how to effectively lead an account, steering processes and ways of working internally, with agency partners and with our clients.<br><br>The ideal candidate will have their finger on the pulse across all things social – from what’s trending that could be a good opportunity for a brand to leverage, through to a thorough understanding of how data, strategy, community management feed into the success of a brands social media presence.</p> <p>Whilst the candidate will have a passion for delivering best in class social campaigns, they will also be required to lead in other areas of the marketing mix, and the idea candidate will have some integrated experience.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>A bit about you:<br><br></strong>We are flexible on whether you have come from an agency of client background, but we think the following are really important for this role:</p> <ul> <li>Organised and autonomous; title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer – AI-Native Software Development
description: <p>At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.</p> <p>We just unveiled JetBrains Central,&nbsp; a platform for agent-driven software development that connects tools, agents, and infrastructure. It enables automated AI workflows to run, be monitored, and be managed across teams – with clear visibility into results, costs, and performance.</p> <p>JetBrains Central provides three core capabilities:<br><strong>Governance and control: </strong>Policy enforcement, identity and access management, observability, auditability, and cost attribution for agent-driven work. Some of these functionalities are already available via the <a href="http://console.jetbrains.cloud/">JetBrains Central Console</a>.<br><strong>Agent execution infrastructure:&nbsp;</strong>Cloud agent runtimes and computation provisioning that allow agents to run reliably across development environments.<br><strong>Agent optimization and context:</strong> Shared semantic context across repositories and projects, enabling agents to access relevant knowledge, and task routing to the most appropriate models or tools.</p> <p>Inside the Professional Services department, we are building a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help our customers adopt AI-native development with JetBrains Central and enable JetBrains consulting partners to transform their customers’ AI-native software development lifecycle.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with early adopter customers to deploy JetBrains Central platform into complex enterprise environments and help them move from experimental AI usage to governed, scalable AI-native development.</p> <p>You will act as a trusted advisor to customer engineering teams and consulting partners, while also mentoring other Forward Deployed Engineers and helping with complex deployments. In this role, you will help establish best practices for enterprise AI adoption and influence how organizations implement AI-driven software development.</p> <p>This role is often a strong fit for engineers who have previously served as Principal or Staff Engineers, Heads of Engineering, CTOs, or Solutions Architects and who enjoy working directly with customers while staying deeply involved with complex technical systems.</p> <p>This role combines consulting, architecture, and hands-on engineering. Your work in the field will directly influence how our platform evolves and how enterprises adopt AI-driven development.</p> <p>You will work directly with the world’s most innovative companies — our client base includes 420 of the Fortune 500 — ensuring they maximize the value of their JetBrains investments.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deploy JetBrains Central platform into enterprise development environments, CI/CD systems, and internal developer platforms.</li> <li>Help organizations transition from ad-hoc AI experimentation to governed AI-native development workflows.</li> <li>Implement enterprise AI governance, including security policies, access management, and data privacy controls.</li> <li>Enable observability for AI-driven development to help organizations understand their AI usage and its impact on productivity, as well as their code-generation patterns.</li> <li>Design sustainable AI adoption strategies, including usage controls and cost visibility across multiple model providers.</li> <li>Integrate our cloud-based agent execution layer, allowing AI agents to run securely and at scale.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with JetBrains product teams to shape the platform based on real-world deployments and customer feedback.</li> <li>Create delivery frameworks and train JetBrains partners to deliver the desired scope of service.</li> <li>Mentor and support other Forward Deployed Engineers, sharing architectural expertise and helping to scale the team’s deployment practices.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You will thrive in this role if you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A consultant at heart who can communicate effectively with both engineers and technical leadership.</li> <li>Able to see the whole picture of the software development lifecycle across developer tools, infrastructure, APIs, and cloud systems.</li> <li>Experienced at integrating complex software systems into enterprise environments.</li> <li>Curious about the future of AI agents and AI-native software development.</li> <li>Comfortable working with early adopters and overcoming ambiguous technical challenges.</li> <li>Motivated to mentor other engineers and contribute to building a new technical discipline.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in software-related projects, ideally in a customer-facing or consulting environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with Java or Python.</li> <li>Experience building or integrating developer platforms, infrastructure systems, or software solutions.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern development workflows (CI/CD, developer environments, internal developer platforms, etc.).</li> <li>Experience working directly with customers or technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate in fast-evolving technical environments.</li> <li>Ability and desire to travel to meet customers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>These would be a plus, but are not blockers</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with industry-specific solutions (fintech, telco, retail, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with AI/LLM platforms, agent frameworks, or AI-assisted development tools.<br>Experience in solutions engineering, consulting, or forward-deployed engineering roles.</li> <li>Familiarity with the JetBrains ecosystem or developer productivity tooling.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-KP1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.jetbrains.com/legal/docs/privacy/privacy-recruitment/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a></em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

OTA & Release Engineering: Own how software gets onto devices: staged rollouts, health checks, automatic rollback, and the confidence that a bad release won't take down a ward. Observability: Design the telemetry, logging, and alerting that tell us a device is degrading before a nurse notices. Make remote debugging possible so we don't fly to fix things. Device Bring-Up & Debugging: Work with our hardware and firmware teams on new hardware revisions, reproduce field issues on the bench, and get to the bottom of problems that span kernel, driver, network, and application. Familiarity with Linux internals: systemd, kernel modules, device tree, networking stack, containers. Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar) and designing what to measure, not just wiring up dashboards. Comfortable with hardware debugging: serial consoles, working alongside hardware engineers Understanding of communication protocols and how devices talk to each other and to us: I2C, SPI, UART, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, MQTT. Pragmatism about networks you don't control: restrictive hospital IT, VLANs, proxies, flaky Wi-Fi, and long offline periods. raw.description:
About Us

At Teton, we are redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology. Facing a global nursing shortage, our solutions offer vital support to overburdened health systems. With thousands of patient rooms across 4 countries already benefiting from our technology, we are aiming to expand to much more. We distinguish ourselves by focusing relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, rapidly deploying solutions that make a real difference.

The Job

Every patient room we deploy into puts another device on infrastructure we don't control, in a building we can't easily visit, running software that has to keep working. We're looking for an Engineer to own that problem: the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that let us ship to thousands of edge devices confidently and understand what they're doing once they're out there.

In this role, you will focus on the following areas of interest:

  • Fleet Management: Build and run the systems that provision, monitor, and manage our devices in the field, from first boot in a hospital room to end of life.

  • OTA & Release Engineering: Own how software gets onto devices: staged rollouts, health checks, automatic rollback, and the confidence that a bad release won't take down a ward.

  • Observability: Design the telemetry, logging, and alerting that tell us a device is degrading before a nurse notices. Make remote debugging possible so we don't fly to fix things.

  • Device Bring-Up & Debugging: Work with our hardware and firmware teams on new hardware revisions, reproduce field issues on the bench, and get to the bottom of problems that span kernel, driver, network, and application.

  • Infrastructure & Tooling: Build the CI/CD, image builds, and internal tools that let the whole engineering team ship to hardware quickly and safely.

  • Documentation: Maintain clear and detailed documentation of your work to ensure easy collaboration and knowledge sharing within the team.

Qualifications:

  • Solid experience running Linux systems in production: ideally embedded or edge Linux, not just cloud VMs.

  • Proficiency in Rust and/or Javascript/Typescript and/or Python

  • Experience with device fleets at scale: provisioning, OTA update mechanisms (Mender, RAUC, balena, or something you built yourself), and remote access to constrained devices.

  • Familiarity with Linux internals: systemd, kernel modules, device tree, networking stack, containers.

  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar) and designing what to measure, not just wiring up dashboards.

  • Comfortable with hardware debugging: serial consoles, working alongside hardware engineers

  • Understanding of communication protocols and how devices talk to each other and to us: I2C, SPI, UART, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, MQTT.

  • Pragmatism about networks you don't control: restrictive hospital IT, VLANs, proxies, flaky Wi-Fi, and long offline periods.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

  • Experience with the NVIDIA Jetson platform and Linux for Tegra is a big plus.

  • Experience with Yocto, Debian packaging, or custom image builds is a plus.

  • Experience in the medical device or healthcare technology field is a plus.

What We Offer

  • Participation in our warrant program (stock options).

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

  • A role where you can make a significant impact on healthcare delivery.

Join Our Team

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job. At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work. If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

Product & AI

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

As Technical Product Manager, AI Systems, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us.
